verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers full-text/hybrid/vector search, semantic_text, and serverless deployment, but contains no mention of completion suggesters, search-as-you-type fields, or any mechanism for building autocomplete/query-suggestion features from a suggestions index or logged search traffic. Missing for 10: any documentation of suggester/autocomplete field types, query-log-based suggestion pipelines, or ranking of suggestions by traffic popularity.
